sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: In the story 'The Crow', why was the bird flying around?
options: C) Looking for water because it was thirsty
D) Looking for a tree to sleep
questions.answer: C) Looking for water because it was thirsty

questions.question_text: Which of the following is a Proper Noun (a special name)?
Choose the correct preposition: The cat is hiding ____ the table.
Choose the correct article: She is eating ____ orange.
How can we know a flower is nearby 'without seeing' it?
options: B) By smelling its sweet scent
questions.answer: B) By smelling its sweet scent

questions.question_text: Identify the action word (verb) in this sentence: The children are playing football.
Choose the correct joining word (conjunction): I like to eat apples ____ bananas.
In 'This is My Town', where do people go when they are sick?
Choose the correct pronoun: ____ is a good girl.
Which sentence has the correct punctuation?
What did the clever crow do to drink the water from the pitcher? (Write in 1-2 sentences)
questions.answer: The clever crow picked up small pebbles and dropped them into the pitcher. This made the water come up so he could drink it.

questions.question_text: Name two important places you can find in a town or city. (Write in 1 sentence)
questions.answer: Two important places in a town are a school and a hospital.

questions.question_text: How can you help a person who cannot see? (Write in 1-2 sentences)
questions.answer: I can help a person who cannot see by gently holding their hand and helping them cross the road safely.

questions.question_text: Why do we say 'We are all Indians' even if we speak different languages? (Write in 1-2 sentences)
questions.answer: We say we are all Indians because even though we have different languages and clothes, we all belong to one beautiful country, India.

questions.question_text: Write down two things you see on your way between your home and school. (Write in 1 sentence)
questions.answer: On my way to school, I see a big green park and a busy market.

sections.section_name: Section C - Grammar & Matching (Fill in the Blanks)

questions.question_text: Fill in the blanks with the correct 'to be' verbs (is, am, are): 1. I ___ riding my bicycle. 2. The birds ___ flying in the sky. 3. He ___ my best friend.
Match the naming words (nouns) with their describing words (adjectives): 1. Sun -> ____ 2. Ice cream -> ____ 3. Tree -> ____ (Choose from: Cold, Green, Bright)
Imagine you have a magic bicycle that can fly. Where would you go and what would you see? Write 3-4 sentences.
questions.answer: If I had a magic bicycle, I would fly high up into the sky. I would pedal all the way to the moon and ride on the craters. I would see the bright shining stars up close and maybe even meet a friendly alien.

questions.question_text: Look at the sky in your imagination. Write 3 sentences describing the different shapes you see in the clouds.
questions.answer: The white clouds look like big fluffy balls of cotton candy. One cloud looks exactly like a giant sleeping dog. Another cloud is shaped like a fast car racing across the blue sky.
